scenes.hook: Type a task, click Add, and put it in a list. Here is the basic idea.
scenes.idea: Use an input, an Add button, and an unordered list. Connect the button to a click handler.
scenes.code: Read the input and trim extra spaces. If it is empty, stop before creating anything.
scenes.result: Create a list item, set its text content, then append it to the list.
scenes.tip: Clear the input so the next task is easy to enter. Add a remove button to each item.
scenes.caution: When Remove is clicked, remove that item. Text content displays user input as plain text.
scenes.try: Try adding one task and removing it. This version does not save tasks after a refresh.
scenes.close: Subscribe to Tech at sixty for more beginner projects.
